steps.content: Having collected plenty of interesting information, you organize the facts and decide to bring them back to Du Ruo in the Bureau first. You also need some rest to recover your strength.

Ever since the shackles came into contact with the Sun Crow, your body has never fully recovered and you've been having this persistent low-grade fever. The exertion of the past half-day has worn you out, and once you get back, you soon fall asleep in your office.

In the dream, something is scorching your skin. Whispers of Mania and roars of a beast drill into your ears. Some chaotic, lacerated consciousness is forcefully tearing through, trying to invade your mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmph!

Flames lash out at you, and the sharp golden eye of a fierce bird captures all your attention. Sparks spatter onto your body, causing unbearable pain, but fear swallows you whole before you can react.

Is this a dream? You don't have time to think as you struggle to cower away instinctively. But the monster screeches and lunges forward, pinning you to the ground with its sword and claws beside your ears. Trapped, you are forced to look at its true form.

That is not a beast. It has the shape of a human, a woman bathing in fire whose body is covered in red feathers. She sits atop you like a hunter on its prey, leaning down close to your face, the intense heat of the fire suffocating you as she draws nearer.
She opens her mouth near your neck, and her whispers mixed with the crackling of burning debris numb the back of your ears.

You try to struggle, but unable to release the shackles in the dream, you remain imprisoned in the cage of flames. The charring smell surrounds you as the world gets incinerated, as if this isn't a dream, but a true purgatory.
And death is beckoning to you.

The flames recede and her face leans even closer. Half of it is covered by an ominous cluster of contamination, like she's wearing a bent mask. The other half is indistinct against the backlight, leaving only that golden eye visible, clear and sharp.
That's not a human eye, but it's not menacing as a demonic beast's either. It's simply staring at you, like... a golden sun.

As you think that, the lapping flames gradually lose their heat, no longer causing the burning pain, but acting like a barrier protecting you in this inferno. The raging Mania outside is entirely consumed by the flames enveloping her body.
She locks eyes with you without any other movement, only repeating the chaotic whispers over and over again. That inhuman pupil seems eager to convey a thousand emotions to you.
But you can't comprehend them. The distance between you is not just a matter of inches, but an insurmountable difference.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who... are you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What are you trying to tell me?
Chief... Chief...
Chief is awake!
A small hand is slapping your cheek, and you wake up to see Yanyan's face instead of the monster's. She looks at you with concern.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Your cheeks are all red, and you're panting... Are you having a fever? You're scaring me.
Maybe it's because you slapped them so hard? You only remark inwardly, then raise your hands to move the girl aside.

options: I'm fine, it was just a dream.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You had a dream again...?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Did you dream of a woman wearing a mask and extraordinary clothes, with flames all over her body... She leaned very close to look at you, embrace you, and try to talk to you?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, did you have the same dream, Chief? Yanyan is the chosen seer who receives oracles through her psychic dreams. How do you explain your dream then?
You're still pondering when the girl claps her hands joyfully and jumps up.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You had the same wonderful dream as Yanyan did! You also dreamed of <color=#fb9259>the Great Seer</color>!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yes! In Sunsink City... Oh, back then it was still called Sunset Town. The Great Seer was the most powerful person in Sunset Town. We were only able to repel all evil spirits and overcome natural disasters thanks to her leadership!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: She always wore a mask and her pretty seer robes. She would stand on the high altar accompanied by her long sword and flames, performing the ritual dance to drive away evil spirits and pray for blessings. What a beautiful sight!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Actually, I dreamed of her just now when I was dozing off in the car too. Hehe, maybe because tackling the Sun Crow is too hard, the Great Seer even came specially to comfort me... It's been a long time since I had such a beautiful dream...
Mask... Long sword... Flames... Woman... You indeed dreamed of the same things again.
But can you call that hellish scene a beautiful dream? That being, burned to the point it no longer looked human... You could hardly see it as a beautiful and gentle woman.

options: What did the Great Seer say to you?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm... She told Yanyan to go to some sea... and she told me I could do it. Although I didn't hear the rest clearly, but... she must be encouraging me.

options: What she told me was different.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Huh? Well... Du Ruo is better at interpreting dreams! Let's go find her!
She takes your hand and runs outside. You consider for a second and don't stop her.
Never mind that strange dream. At Du Ruo's request, you've specifically brought back a lot of information for her. You wonder if the scholar has figured anything out yet.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Watching the High Tower Black Ring collapse from the helicopter... Man, how do I put it... I couldn't imagine the person who did such a big thing was our Chief. I mean, our skinny Chief with those heavy dark circles from all the overtime, who we see every day!

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: Who'd have thought? When the second Black Ring erupted, they said Chief was dead. I thought I'd never see him again!
steps.female_content: Who'd have thought? When the second Black Ring erupted, they said Chief was dead. I thought I'd never see her again!

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: Eek! Chief!
You walk over to find a few loudmouths from the Bureau chattering to Du Ruo, and they scurry off the second they see you. The scholar nods at you with a smile, her expression full of amusement.
You steady your emotions and smile at Yanyan.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll ask her about the dream. Go play somewhere else, Yanyan. But don't listen to those stories. Read the actual reports.

options: I'm braver in real life than in the stories.
Don't get your hopes up. I'm not that bright.

steps.content: Getting your permission, the girl bounces about joyfully. She's already forgotten about the dream and is now captivated by those tales of Chief's Great Adventures spun by those two.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Then I'll be off! Tell me how my dream differs from yours later. I really want to know too!
She runs off gleefully, leaving you and Du Ruo alone.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Bummer, my field research was just getting interesting. "Skinny Chief Strikes Back and Mad Shackles vs. Mania." How fascinating!

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Never mind, you're my priority. Finally willing to let me interpret your dream?

options: I'm not here to talk about the dream.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We agreed to talk about that only when we can finally face each other honestly. But the things you've done...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Refusing to go out using different excuses. Being vague about everything. Sending me away to "gather information" and then snooping around in the Bureau. You're making it hard to trust you, you know.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Are you upset because I neglected your investigation results, or are you indeed here to interrogate the Outlander?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need an explanation. I can't work with someone suspicious.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: To think that one would doubt the truthfulness of a scholar's words... Not gonna let this slide if I say nothing, are you?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sigh... Alright, alright.
She actually straightens up and looks at you earnestly, the humor in her tone all gone.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: My homeland is not like DisCity. Eastia is ever the victim of disasters, and our people struggle to survive. My studies in mythology, frequent overseas journeys, and information gathering in DisCity are all to grasp these unpredictable disasters. For example...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In N.F. 112, Eastia faced a massive Tide of Ashes. Several cities were destroyed and vast lands sank beneath the sea. That would later be known in DisCity as the Sinking of Eastia.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In N.F. 113, just when we barely suppressed the Sun Crow Apostle, it suddenly broke free from its seal, catching us off guard and severely damaging the newly revived Sunsink City.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: These are the two most recent disasters which even our seers did not foresee. Yet, in DisCity, I found some interesting clues.
She looks at you, the warmth in her eyes cooling slightly.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In August N.F. 112, on the brink of the sinking of Eastia, a certain Chief awoke from a slumber. In March N.F. 113, after he was attacked and fell into a coma, the Sun Crow broke its seal and went berserk thousands of miles away. I'm sure you're smart enough to connect the dots...
steps.female_content: In August N.F. 112, on the brink of the sinking of Eastia, a certain Chief awoke from a slumber. In March N.F. 113, after she was attacked and fell into a coma, the Sun Crow broke its seal and went berserk thousands of miles away. I'm sure you're smart enough to connect the dots...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It's just a speculation. I have no solid proof.
She smiles and steps closer smoothly to whisper in your ear. Is it your imagination, or is there indeed a hint of hostility in her voice?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Your people are the center of the world and the center of Mania. Your every unconscious action might trigger a disaster that affects everyone, and yet you've been reluctant to see it.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Think about what you've done and who is really the one to be doubted and hated?
With that, you find the two of you locking eyes, standing merely a foot apart. Without waiting for your answer, Du Ruo's smile fades as she looks away and stands up to go, leaving you there alone.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Chief? Hehe, you're still here. Tell me the result of the dream interpretation. I'm dying to know the good news!
You're still collecting yourself.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yeah! I saw Du Ruo come out just now covering her mouth and giggling all the way. It's rare to see her so happy. There must be some good news, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Giggling?

Dammit! You finally realize Du Ruo has dodged your question. You hurry out to the corridor, but the suspect is long gone. Those nonsensical words were just a bluff to scare you. That trickster played you again!
Frustrated, you make to chase after her, but Yanyan grabs your sleeve again.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Wait, wait! Du Ruo asked me to tell you something.
Another arrangement made by that woman. You quiver and swallow hard. Who knows what she is planning to play on you this time?

options: ...What does she want you to tell me?

steps.content: Seemingly oblivious to your wary and puzzled look, Yanyan breaks into a big smile and hugs you tightly.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Thank you for always being with me, believing in me, and showing me all the fun things. ${PlayerName}, no matter where you're from, Yanyan adores you, even if you believe in those strange blue and red crystals!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Let's go! The mission isn't over yet. I have to work hard. I'll definitely defeat the Sun Crow. I'll protect Chief and DisCity, your homeland!
The straightforward declaration of affection following Du Ruo's roundabout threatening bluff throws your thoughts into complete disarray. Tongue-tied, you come up with only one conclusion...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These two Outlanders are both intimidating in their own ways. Can't let my guard down with them, not even a little!
Remembering ${PlayerName}'s shocked expression at her threat, Du Ruo chuckles lightly and strolls through the Bureau's long corridor.

His great deeds and miraculous shackles aside, that one is indeed beloved by those around him. He's also truly naive and kind, and almost too honest. Even that kind of lie could make him pale with shock.
steps.female_content: Her great deeds and miraculous shackles aside, that one is indeed beloved by those around her. She's also truly naive and kind, and almost too honest. Even that kind of lie could make her pale with shock.

steps.content: Outside the scholar's room, an agent from the 9th Agency leans against the wall. Seeing Du Ruo, he removes his hat in greeting. Du Ruo smiles and returns the gesture before entering the room alone.
Her smile fades as she flips through the documents ${PlayerName} brought back, recalling what Yanyan just said.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Then I'll be off! Tell me how my dream differs from yours later. I really want to know too!

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Two different psychic dreams...

The characteristics of Eastian seers can be deduced from comparison with the research on Sinners. Black Rings have only appeared within DisCity, and the "Mania contamination" they produce is unique. Sinners born from them are thus more diverse and strange, their minds unstable. Such severe contamination does not exist in Eastia. Seers are born when their innate psychic gift awakens, likely induced by Mania disasters. The awoken ones are also more likely to resonate with the "deities" that awakened them and possess similar Mania properties. This is known as "channeling".
Those two cuties brought back a lot of interesting information. I'll be waiting for the Ring Research Institute's analysis report...
